title: Worksheet 2: Talking to Strangers Online
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: On Roblox, players can talk to millions of other users, and most of these players are complete strangers. Some strangers online are simply other kids who enjoy the same games, but because it is easy for anyone to hide their real identity online, a player can never be completely sure who they are truly talking to. Someone chatting on Roblox could claim to be a kid the same age, when in reality they might be an adult, or a much older teenager, pretending to be younger to gain trust. This is one reason experts recommend that kids never share personal details with people they meet only through games, and never agree to move a conversation to a different app or website without checking with a trusted adult first. If a stranger online ever makes a player feel confused, pressured, or uncomfortable in any way, the safest choice is to stop talking to them, avoid responding further, and tell a trusted adult right away.
